title: NanoVI pipeline parameters
description: Taxonomic classification of full-length 16S rRNA Nanopore reads using variational inference

input.description: Path to input samplesheet CSV or FASTQ directory

db.description: Path to NanoVI/GTDB reference database directory

taxonomy_tsv.description: Path to taxonomy TSV file matching the reference database

kmer_size.description: K-mer size for minimap2 alignment indexing and mapping

N.description: Maximum number of secondary alignments reported by minimap2 per read

split_prefix.description: Prefix for minimap2 temporary split index files

min_length.description: Minimum read length for FastpLong quality filter (bp)

max_length.description: Maximum read length for FastpLong quality filter (bp)

keep_counts.description: Include estimated read counts column in output abundance tables

keep_files.description: Retain intermediate files (SAM alignments, filtered FASTQs) in output directory

db_name.description: Name for the custom database to build

sequences.description: Path to input FASTA file with reference sequences

seq2tax.description: Path to sequence-to-taxonomy mapping TSV file

ncbi_taxonomy.description: Path to NCBI taxonomy dump directory (containing names.dmp and nodes.dmp)

taxonomy_list.description: Path to taxonomy terms list TSV file

input_tsv.description: Path to abundance table TSV for taxonomy collapse

input_dir.description: Path to directory containing per-sample abundance tables for combining

rank.description: Taxonomic rank for collapse or combine operations
